scientific_integrity: The referenced 2012 formula was explicitly a conjecture, not a new proposed identity; the contribution is an all-moduli proof via a matrix projector. Computational checks are supporting tests and not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Odd moduli n >= 3 and base n-1 only; integer cutoffs. Full infinite proof given. Earlier authors supplied the spectral polynomial and digit-step formulas separately; prior independent proof or stronger theorem is an acknowledged residual originality risk.
title: A universal spectral projector resolves the odd-modulus Newman digit-sum conjecture
